GOT QUESTIONS?

Specialty Coverage FAQ

Clear, expert answers regarding agreed value appraisals, aviation, marine, and unique risk floaters.

Specialty Coverage encompasses unique, high-value, or non-standard risks that standard personal or commercial policies exclude or cap. Examples include collector vehicles, private aircraft, mega-yachts, fine art, rare wine cellars, antique jewelry, special event cancellations, and executive cyber threats.
Unlike standard policies that pay actual cash value (which factors in heavy depreciation), an Agreed Value policy guarantees that you and Surebound agree on the item's exact financial value prior to policy issuance. In the event of a total loss, you receive 100% of that agreed sum with no depreciation deducted.
Yes. Our Aviation and Marine specialty floaters include tailored navigation and territorial limits designed around your flight paths and maritime routes, offering seamless worldwide hull and liability coverage.
For high-value items (typically items over $50,000 individually), a recent appraisal from a certified appraiser or a detailed sales bill of sale is required to establish the agreed value baseline. Our risk officers assist with arranging qualified appraisals.
Preliminary specialty risk proposals are generated within 24 to 48 hours following an initial evaluation with our senior underwriting desk.
